answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 12112 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Asslamalaikum.. I smoke cigrette, i want to know is Cigrette Haram, as i heard from some one Smoking Cigrette is haram. Question: Asslamalaikum.. I smoke cigrette, i want to know is Cigrette Haram, as i heard from some one Smoking Cigrette is haram. Answer ID: 12112 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 888/662=H/1430) It is makrooh to smoke unnecessarily. If it is causing diseases, then it is haram . It is makrooh-e-tahreemi if one goes to mosques etc without removing the bad smell causing problem for people and angels. It is better to abstain from smoking as soon as possible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
